displayIdentity.body: A doxology names the revealed mystery and obedience of faith. Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages, to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.
